column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 03（i 10181–10270）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
# 10223 的例句改写过（原句里是 Overconsumption，应用在句子里找不到 consumption），见 build_ielts.py 的 EDITED。
10181 § oncology § She specialises in paediatric oncology. § 她专攻儿童**肿瘤学**。
10182 § pandemic § The pandemic disrupted education worldwide. § 这场**大流行病**扰乱了全球的教育。
10183 § pathogen § A pathogen is a microorganism that causes disease. § **病原体**是引起疾病的微生物。
10184 § pharmacy § You can buy the medicine at any pharmacy. § 你可以在任何一家**药房**买到这种药。
10185 § physiology § Exercise affects the physiology of the whole body. § 运动会影响全身的**生理机能**。
10186 § prevalence § The prevalence of obesity has risen sharply. § 肥胖的**患病率**急剧上升。
10187 § prevention § Prevention is better than cure. § **预防**胜于治疗。
10188 § prognosis § The prognosis for recovery is generally good. § 康复的**预后**总体良好。
10189 § psychiatry § Psychiatry deals with mental disorders. § **精神病学**处理精神障碍问题。
10190 § psychology § Psychology explains why people behave as they do. § **心理学**解释了人们为何会有那样的行为。
10191 § rehabilitation § Rehabilitation helps patients regain their independence. § **康复治疗**帮助患者重获自理能力。
10192 § resilience § Resilience helps people cope with stress and setbacks. § **韧性**帮助人们应对压力和挫折。
10193 § respiratory § Smoking causes respiratory diseases such as bronchitis. § 吸烟会引发支气管炎等**呼吸**系统疾病。
10194 § risk factor § Smoking is a major risk factor for heart disease. § 吸烟是心脏病的一个主要**风险因素**。
10195 § screening § Regular screening can detect cancer at an early stage. § 定期**筛查**可以在早期发现癌症。
10196 § sedentary § A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of obesity. § **久坐**的生活方式会增加肥胖的风险。
10197 § side effect § The drug has few serious side effects. § 这种药几乎没有严重的**副作用**。
10198 § stress § Prolonged stress damages both body and mind. § 长期的**压力**会损害身心。
10199 § surgery § He underwent surgery to repair the injury. § 他接受了**手术**来修复伤处。
10200 § symptom § Fever is a common symptom of the flu. § 发烧是流感的常见**症状**。
10201 § syndrome § Chronic fatigue syndrome is poorly understood. § 人们对慢性疲劳**综合征**了解甚少。
10202 § therapy § Cognitive behavioural therapy helps treat anxiety. § 认知行为**疗法**有助于治疗焦虑症。
10203 § treatment § New treatments have improved survival rates. § 新的**治疗**方法提高了存活率。
10204 § vaccine § The vaccine offers strong protection against the virus. § 这种**疫苗**能提供针对该病毒的强力保护。
10205 § wellbeing § Regular exercise improves physical and mental wellbeing. § 经常锻炼能改善身心**健康**。
10206 § sanitation § Poor sanitation spreads infectious diseases. § 糟糕的**环境卫生**会传播传染病。
10207 § hygiene § Personal hygiene is essential to prevent infection. § 个人**卫生**对预防感染至关重要。
10208 § addiction § Internet addiction is a growing concern among teenagers. § 青少年中的网络**成瘾**问题日益受到关注。
10209 § diagnose § The illness was diagnosed at an early stage. § 这种疾病在早期就被**诊断**了出来。
10210 § accountability § Public officials should be held to a high standard of accountability. § 公职人员应当接受高标准的**问责**。
10211 § activism § Climate activism has grown rapidly among young people. § 气候**行动主义**在年轻人中迅速发展。
10212 § assimilation § Cultural assimilation can erode minority languages. § 文化**同化**可能侵蚀少数民族语言。
10213 § attitude § Public attitudes towards recycling are changing. § 公众对回收利用的**态度**正在改变。
10214 § autonomy § Teenagers increasingly demand autonomy from their parents. § 青少年越来越要求拥有不受父母支配的**自主权**。
10215 § behaviour § Social norms strongly influence human behaviour. § 社会规范强烈影响着人类的**行为**。
10216 § citizenship § Citizenship brings both rights and responsibilities. § **公民身份**既带来权利，也带来责任。
10217 § coercion § No one should be made to act under coercion. § 任何人都不应在**胁迫**之下被迫行事。
10218 § collective § The decision was made for the collective good. § 这一决定是为了**集体**利益而做出的。
10219 § compliance § Compliance with traffic laws saves lives. § **遵守**交通法规能挽救生命。
10220 § conflict § The conflict between work and family time is common. § 工作与家庭时间之间的**冲突**很常见。
10221 § conformity § Teenagers often seek conformity with their peers. § 青少年常常追求与同龄人**保持一致**。
10222 § consensus § It took hours to reach a consensus at the meeting. § 会议上花了好几个小时才达成**共识**。
10223 § consumption § Excessive consumption places a heavy burden on the planet. § 过度**消费**给地球带来了沉重的负担。
10224 § cooperation § International cooperation is essential to solve global problems. § 解决全球性问题离不开国际**合作**。
10225 § culture § Each country has its own unique culture. § 每个国家都有自己独特的**文化**。
10226 § democracy § Free elections are a cornerstone of democracy. § 自由选举是**民主**的基石。
10227 § discrimination § Laws prohibit discrimination on the basis of gender. § 法律禁止基于性别的**歧视**。
10228 § disparity § There is a wide disparity in income between regions. § 各地区之间的收入存在很大**差距**。
10229 § diversity § Cultural diversity enriches a society. § 文化**多样性**丰富了社会。
10230 § empowerment § Education is a tool of empowerment for women. § 教育是女性**赋权**的工具。
10231 § equality § The law guarantees equality of opportunity for all. § 法律保障人人享有机会**平等**。
10232 § ethnicity § People of every ethnicity are represented in the survey. § 调查涵盖了各个**族裔**的人群。
10233 § exclusion § Social exclusion can lead to poverty and crime. § 社会**排斥**可能导致贫困和犯罪。
10234 § freedom § Freedom of speech is protected by law. § 言论**自由**受法律保护。
10235 § gender § Gender equality benefits the whole economy. § **性别**平等有利于整个经济。
10236 § governance § Good governance is essential for sustainable development. § 良好的**治理**对可持续发展至关重要。
10237 § heritage § The town is proud of its cultural heritage. § 这座小镇为自己的文化**遗产**感到自豪。
10238 § hierarchy § The company has a strict management hierarchy. § 这家公司有严格的管理**等级制度**。
10239 § identity § Language is closely tied to national identity. § 语言与民族**身份认同**紧密相连。
10240 § ideology § Political ideology shapes how people interpret events. § 政治**意识形态**塑造着人们解读事件的方式。
10241 § inclusion § Social inclusion gives everyone equal access to opportunities. § 社会**包容**让每个人都有平等获得机会的途径。
10242 § indigenous § Indigenous communities have their own languages and traditions. § **原住民**社区有自己的语言和传统。
10243 § inequality § Economic inequality is widening in many countries. § 许多国家的经济**不平等**正在扩大。
10244 § institution § Universities are important public institutions. § 大学是重要的公共**机构**。
10245 § integration § Successful integration helps migrants settle in a new country. § 成功的**融合**有助于移民在新国家安顿下来。
10246 § justice § The justice system must treat everyone fairly. § **司法**制度必须公平对待每一个人。
10247 § legitimacy § Free elections give a government its legitimacy. § 自由选举赋予政府**合法性**。
10248 § marginalise § New technology can marginalise older workers. § 新技术可能使年长的员工**边缘化**。
10249 § migration § Rural-to-urban migration is reshaping cities. § 从农村到城市的**人口迁移**正在重塑城市。
10250 § mobility § Social mobility is harder to achieve in unequal societies. § 在不平等的社会里，社会**流动性**更难实现。
10251 § norms § Social norms change slowly over time. § 社会**规范**随着时间推移缓慢变化。
10252 § participation § Public participation improves the quality of decision-making. § 公众**参与**能提高决策的质量。
10253 § prejudice § Prejudice against certain groups remains widespread. § 对某些群体的**偏见**依然普遍存在。
10254 § race § People of all races should enjoy equal rights. § 所有**种族**的人都应享有平等的权利。
10255 § reform § The education reform aims to improve teaching quality. § 这项教育**改革**旨在提高教学质量。
10256 § resistance § There was strong resistance to the new policy. § 人们对这项新政策有强烈的**抵制**。
10257 § rights § Human rights are protected by international law. § **人权**受国际法保护。
10258 § segregation § The law ended racial segregation in schools. § 这部法律终结了学校里的种族**隔离**。
10259 § social cohesion § Trust between neighbours strengthens social cohesion. § 邻里之间的信任增强了**社会凝聚力**。
10260 § stereotype § Stereotypes about gender limit people's potential. § 关于性别的**刻板印象**限制了人们的潜能。
10261 § stigma § Mental illness still carries a stigma in many societies. § 在许多社会里，精神疾病仍然背负着**污名**。
10262 § welfare § The welfare system supports the most vulnerable. § **福利**制度为最弱势的群体提供支持。
10263 § xenophobia § Xenophobia often rises during economic downturns. § 经济衰退期间，**仇外心理**往往会上升。
10264 § demographic § Demographic changes are affecting the labour market. § **人口结构**的变化正在影响劳动力市场。
10265 § solidarity § The community showed great solidarity after the disaster. § 灾难过后，这个社区展现出了极强的**团结**精神。
10266 § status § Education is seen as a route to higher social status. § 教育被视为通往更高社会**地位**的途径。
10267 § tradition § Many traditions are passed down through generations. § 许多**传统**代代相传。
10268 § values § Family values are deeply rooted in many cultures. § 家庭**价值观**在许多文化中根深蒂固。
10269 § acquisition § The company announced the acquisition of a smaller rival. § 该公司宣布**收购**一家规模较小的竞争对手。
10270 § asset § Land is a valuable asset for many families. § 土地对许多家庭来说是宝贵的**资产**。
